@@ Contacting
@stat: Re
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus to locating individuals of influence or
  knowledge within an urban environment. It includes edge of where such
  individuals may be found as well a information involving how they might be
  reached (e.g., locating boss or fence, politician, etc.). This skill is the
  equivalent Scrounging except that it operates for individuals or locations.
  Note that actual interaction with such persons are covered skills in the
  Influence Skill Category.

@@ Mingling
@stat: Ag
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus to attempts to mix easily large urban
  population, whether for the purposes of remaining unnoticed, escaping
  pursuers, or simply moving easily through crowd.  Rolemaster Standard Rules
  206

@@ Scrounging
@stat: Re
@description:
  This skill provides a bonus in being able to come up with knowllocation of
  a particular needed item, part or ingredient. This skill is normally used
  in an urban type of setting. This does not cover a crime locating of food
  or water.  of

  common or underworld society. Note that skill does not necessarily enable a
